description: This file defines the DashboardScreen widget for a Flutter app, showing an overview of attendance data, including summaries, recent attendance, and quick actions. It interacts with multiple provider classes for state management.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget for displaying an overview dashboard including attendance statistics, recent attendance list, and actions.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class for DashboardScreen managing data fetching and UI building logic.

classes.name: _SummaryCard
classes.description: Reusable widget displaying a titled card with a header and content, used for overview sections.

classes.name: _CounterPill
classes.description: Widget representing a small badge with a label and value, indicating attendance counts.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: Widget representing the status of an attendance record with color coding.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Overrides Flutter lifecycle method to trigger initial data fetch once dependencies are established.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI, responsive to layout constraints, displaying dashboard cards, summaries, and attendance lists.

methods.name: _countStatus
methods.description: Counts items with a specific attendance status in a list.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Generates a string key for a date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
